en.faq1_q: How do the five tools work together?
en.faq1_a: They form one loop: Izlai finds and contacts new clients, Ailo answers enquiries within 6 seconds, ILDAM tracks the relationship and payments, Bandla books the appointment and Mirzo records what was agreed in meetings. Information passes between them, so nobody enters it twice.
en.faq2_q: Can we start with just one tool?
en.faq2_a: Yes. Most businesses start with Ailo to handle social media and messaging, or with Bandla to stop missed bookings. You can add the other tools when you are ready.
en.faq3_q: Does it replace our existing CRM or tools?
en.faq3_a: It depends on what you have. GPTify OS includes ILDAM, a clean CRM for service businesses, but it can also pass bookings, contacts and notes into 1C, Google Calendar or your existing database.
en.faq4_a: You do. Your customer data runs on your own accounts or servers, is encrypted at rest and in transit, and is never used to train public AI models.
en.faq5_a: A standard setup for one location or team takes 5 to 10 working days, including connecting your channels, loading your procedures and training your staff.
